name: Progress
description: A transfer bar that fills itself: ten fronts — honeycomb cells, a sloshing wave, a smoke plume, sixty-four threads, resolving grain — each with the title, sub-label and live percentage riding over it. Drop it in with one line, or drive it with a progress prop.

name: Thinking Orbs
description: A ball of dots turning, breathing, draining or blinking inside a status pill — 38 seamless loops for the moment your app is thinking, and twenty knobs over the ball inside them. Drawn as one antialiased disc per dot rather than a full-screen shader, so it costs about a thousandth of one and a wall of them is free.

name: Dust
description: Thousands of glowing dust dashes laid on a turning form and stroked additively over black — a ring stack sheared into a helix, or nested shells breathing. Drawn by a real MetalKit vertex pipeline, one instanced quad per dash, so it costs a fraction of a full-screen shader.

name: Hyperspace
description: A jump to lightspeed on a loop: stars stretch into streaks, the screen flashes white, a tunnel opens, then the ship falls back to a drifting starfield. Four tunnels — a churning blue corridor, raked light rays, an arcing ion storm and racing shards.

params.label: Repeat
params.hint: Jump, wait out the pause, jump again. Off runs it once.

name: Cloth
description: Real fabric, simulated. A verlet sheet you can grab and pull — a solid colour with the fold in it and nothing laid over the top, or a thin-film sheet that shifts colour as it moves. Upload a picture and the cloth wears it.

params.label: Animate
params.hint: A standing breeze — it never repeats and never stops

name: Magenta
description: Hot magenta into white — big soft masses, moderate churn, strong rim light, visible edge fringes. The silhouette holds still while the liquid inside turns: every point rides its own small circle once per loop, so the loop closes with no jump. A marbled four-octave field is graded through an Oklab ramp, split per channel at the rim into fringes, and lit by a rim light and a single glint.

name: Drop
description: Teal into foam into pale glass, with a silhouette that breathes. Three waves — 3, 5 and 7 lobes — travel the rim at different speeds while the core holds still, so the outline swells and pinches while the liquid inside ignores it. Glassy and high in refraction: the field is pulled hard toward the centre as the sphere turns away, then graded through a three-stop Oklab ramp, split per channel at the rim into fringes and finished with a hard glint.

name: Ember Orb
description: Molten streaks over charcoal — a hot, heavy churn lit from the lower right. The silhouette holds still while the liquid inside turns: every point rides its own small circle once per loop, so the loop closes with no jump. A marbled four-octave field is graded through a three-stop Oklab ramp — char, flame, ash — split per channel at the rim into fringes, lit by a rim light and a single glint, and set in a live halo of its own char colour so the heat stands off the ball.

name: Solar Flare
description: White-hot center with a strong outer halo — a small sun. The silhouette holds still while the liquid inside turns: every point rides its own small circle once per loop, so the loop closes with no jump. A marbled four-octave field is graded through a three-stop Oklab ramp — flare orange into gold into a corona white — split per channel at the rim into fringes, lit by a rim light and a single glint, and thrown past the limb by the sheet's own halo.

name: Lava Lamp
description: Six discrete blobs on their own orbits, merging and splitting as they cross — how many, how big and how uneven are all sliders. Violet into rose into amber, with a soft halo past the limb. Each blob has its own radius, its own orbit and its own integer rate, so the whole field returns exactly to where it started once per loop; the inverse-square sum they make is thresholded into a mass with a soft skin, graded through an Oklab ramp, split per channel at the rim, and lit by a rim light and a single glint.

name: Prism
description: Domain-warped value noise read through a cosine palette. Two fbm fields displace the sample point, two more read the warped field, and their weighted sum drives one cosine at three per-channel phases — the whole spectrum out of a shader that holds no colour constant. A raking highlight lifts the upper left, a static film grain sits over the ball in an overlay blend, and two blurred cones, pink over blue, leak past the limb as a halo.

name: Abyss Orb
description: Cold water under pressure. Two bands of five-octave noise warp a third into slow columns of current, a ridged fourth cuts pale veins through them, and Ridge crossfades between the smooth body and the veined one. Four stops carry it from abyssal navy up to pale ice while the whole field drifts upward on its own, independently of the warp working across it.

name: Glass Liquid
description: A fluid seen through frosted glass. Five octaves of rotated value noise, warped by a second pair of the same and ramped through four stops, then buried under the shell that made the original read as glass: a porcelain radial fill, three inset sheens, a rim ramp and two rotated speculars, with the liquid blurred and desaturated behind all of it. Nine palettes — Frost through Smoke — over five distinct flow branches.

name: Cyclone
description: A vortex read through the skin of a ball. Two fbm fields build a slowly drifting warp, then the ball's own coordinate is spun by an angle that decays as a gaussian in the radius — tight at the eye, almost still at the limb — plus a constant rate, so the disc shears rather than turning. A five-octave fbm read in that spun frame, nudged sideways by the warp, ramps through four palette stops before a key light, a fill and the limb roll-off close it.

name: Pyre
description: A column of flame held inside the ball. One five-octave noise field, warped by a finer copy of itself and scrolled downward so the plume reads as climbing, is weighted by height into an intensity that ramps through four stops — soot, ember, flame, spark. The lift from the upper left and the two darkening terms are the shading every liquid orb in the family ends on.

name: Nebula Orb
description: Warm billowing volume around an off-centre ember of a sun. The sphere is implicit — a disc whose z is solved from the radius — and marched front-to-back in eighteen slices, each one sampling two fbm fields (one warping the other) into a density that ramps through four palette stops. What the transmittance leaves lets the ember through.

name: Ferrofluid
description: A near-black magnetic mirror. The sphere is implicit — a disc whose z is solved from the radius — and its normal is bent by the three-tap gradient of a ridged fbm field, growing the cones a magnet pulls out of ferrofluid. Four drifting lights gathered by an exponential lobe stand in for an environment, and a high-f0 Schlick fresnel keeps the body dark so colour only flashes off the spike flanks.

name: Abalone
description: Two fbm fields read on a slowly turning sphere normal stand in for the growth of paua nacre — a coarse one warps a finer one, and the fine field sets a film thickness that a cosine at three wavelengths turns into the green-blue-violet interference colour. A sine across the same normal bands that colour and rotates its channel triplet, so neighbouring growth rings disagree on hue, and the crest of the warp field cuts the dark grooves between them.

name: Nacre
description: Mother-of-pearl. A screen-space disc solves its own z for a surface normal, one fbm kneads a coarse swirl across it and a second, warped by the first, lays a brushed banding over that; the two plus the limb curvature sum into an optical thickness. A per-channel cosine reads that thickness out at three wavelengths and the result is pulled back toward pearl white, so the fringes stay pastel rather than rainbow.

name: Soap Film
description: Thin-film interference on a bubble. A screen-space disc solves its own z to get a surface normal, two rounds of domain-warped fbm knead a thickness field across it, and a per-channel cosine of the optical path turns that thickness into colour. A mirrored copy of the field shades the back surface seen through the interior; the fringes brighten where the film folds and at grazing angles.

name: Struck Film
description: A soap-thin film over a sphere that something keeps striking. Four wave packets are in flight at once — each launched from a hashed point on the surface, expanding as a geodesic ring and decaying as it spreads — and their ripples add to an fbm thickness field that a cosine interference triple turns into rainbow wavefronts. The screen-space derivative of that thickness picks out the creases where colliding fronts crowd, and that is what the glint rides on.

name: Ink Bloom
description: Near-black ink billows silhouetted on a glowing interior, their edges fringed with interference colour. The sphere is implicit — a disc whose z is solved from the radius — and marched front-to-back in sixteen slices, each one folding two fbm fields into a value that splits in two: a body ramp that absorbs light, and a thin band astride the half-contour that emits a per-channel cosine fringe. Whatever transmittance survives lets the interior gradient bloom through.

name: Caustics
description: Layered internal caustic sheets inside a glass ball, kneading in place. The sphere is implicit — a disc whose z is solved from the radius — and marched front-to-back in sixteen slices, each one pulled inward in proportion to its depth so the volume reads as refracted. Two fbm fields warp each other and only the thin shells where either crosses its threshold survive, tinted by a cosine ramp over the field values.

name: Temper
description: An fbm field read on the sphere normal is quantised into seven terraces, each one hashing its own normal offset, so the surface breaks into the stepped facets of a bismuth hopper crystal. A heat pulse sweeps outward from one hot pole each cycle; angular distance from its front sets an oxide thickness, and thin-film interference at three wavelengths turns that thickness into the temper colour sequence dragging across the steps.

name: Obsidian
description: A glass ball refracts the studio wall behind it once per colour channel — three indices of refraction, one fringe — then sphere-traces up to forty-four steps through itself to a stone whose radius is bent by two octaves of fbm. The stone is lit entirely by what it reflects: the wall, a needle-tight key and a violet fresnel. Two specular lobes and a limb glow sit on the glass in front of it. Every colour in the image, down to the wall grade and the lamps, is an editable swatch.

name: Liquid Metal
description: Three metaball droplets fuse and part inside a glass sphere hanging in a studio void. The view ray refracts at the shell — once per channel at three IORs, so the background disperses — then marches forty steps to the metal, which is shaded as a mirror: the room re-sampled along the reflected direction, three specular lobes off one key light, an iridescent band and a low bounce. Every colour on screen is a swatch, down to the wall, the two lamps and both ends of the iridescent band.

name: Smoke Orb
description: Smoke sealed inside a glass ball, floating in a wall-only studio void. The view ray refracts once at the shell and is then marched through sixteen slices of a warped fbm field, each one taking two cheap taps toward the key light for self-shadow and integrating Beer-Lambert transmittance. What the smoke leaves through shows the graded wall behind it, sampled once per channel at three indices of refraction. Every colour in the room is a swatch: the wall gradient, the two lamp bounces, the four glass highlights and the smoke albedo.

name: Wallpaper
description: The Mesh01 grainy wallpapers, 1:1 — a domain-warped fbm field through a five-colour ramp, with film grain and vignette. Eight styles, a seed the Shuffle button rolls, the exact shader exported. iOS 17+.

name: Abyss
description: Midnight ink lit by an electric-blue bloom — the Abyss wallpaper as a draggable SwiftUI MeshGradient. Sixteen points, the Film grade on top, every colour yours. iOS 18+.

params.label: Pin edges
params.hint: Keep drifting points on the frame

name: Ridge Violet
description: A frosted white sheet with a violet landscape glowing up from behind it: three blurred silhouettes stacked light to dark, plus film grain. Three ways to set them moving — a travelling ripple, a tide, or a parallax slide — every colour yours, and the light drags on the canvas.

name: Ridge Indigo
description: A frosted white sheet with an indigo range glowing up from behind it: three blurred silhouettes stacked light to dark, plus film grain. Three ways to set them moving — a travelling ripple, a tide, or a parallax slide — every colour yours, and the light drags on the canvas.

name: Ridge Graphite
description: A frosted white sheet with a slate landscape glowing up from behind it: three blurred silhouettes stacked light to dark, plus film grain. Three ways to set them moving — a travelling ripple, a tide, or a parallax slide — every colour yours, and the light drags on the canvas.

name: Spike Purple
description: A near-black squircle with a violet spike of light rising out of its base and a fine dot screen laid over the top. Three ways to set the light moving, four more for the dots, and the light drags on the canvas.

name: Spike Aqua
description: A near-black squircle with a cyan spike of light rising out of its base and a fine dot screen laid over the top. Three ways to set the light moving, four more for the dots, and the light drags on the canvas.

name: Spike Lime
description: A near-black squircle with a lime spike of light rising out of its base and a fine dot screen laid over the top. Three ways to set the light moving, four more for the dots, and the light drags on the canvas.

name: Filament
description: 180,000 tracers drifting through a live fluid field, each one dragging a light trail through a feedback buffer. The currents draw themselves — cyan filaments where the flow runs fast, gold sparks at the vortex cores, black water in between. Drag to stir it. Exports a self-contained MetalKit renderer.

params.label: Bloom
params.hint: Glow bleeding off the brightest filaments

name: Aurora
description: Curtains of light climbing a night sky — a real fluid simulation whose shape comes from stacked wind shear, smeared upward through ten slices from green at the foot to violet at the crown. Drag across the preview to stir it. Exports a self-contained MetalKit renderer.

name: Mycelium
description: A quarter of a million agents, each smelling the trail ahead-left, ahead and ahead-right, turning toward the strongest and laying down more of it. Nothing draws the network — it is what the agents agree on. Drag to bend it. Exports a self-contained MetalKit renderer.

name: Molten
description: Dark basalt crust cracked open over flowing lava. Two counter-scrolling noise fields warp the sample point so the crust flows, then the warped point is ridged twice — wide for the main veins, tight for the fine fractures — and ramped through four stops from cold rock to white-hot core.

name: Ember
description: Three colour waves blurred into a single glow that pools at the foot of a black well, the white crest travelling further than the red. Three ways to set them moving — a travelling ripple, a tide, or a parallax slide — and the light drags on the canvas.

name: Sweep
description: A magenta light rising out of the card's lower corner through a violet field, with a second lobe holding the right edge. Drag the light on the canvas to move it.

name: Duotone
description: A magenta-to-midnight sky raked at 138 degrees, cut by one long blurred band with a rose blush leaning in from the corner. Drag the light on the canvas to move it.

name: Chrome
description: A white halo hanging over the top edge of a black card, its cool spill washing down the face and a dark foot pulling the base back to nothing. Drag the light on the canvas to move the halo.

name: Glow
description: A lit card: a near-black fill with four bands of light rising off one edge, and film grain over the lot. Drag the light on the canvas, pick one of five animations to move it, and resize the card to anything.

name: Halo
description: A card lit from inside its own edges: four inset bands growing inward, a radial core holding the centre dark, and film grain over the lot. Drag the light on the canvas to move it.

name: Wave
description: A half-ellipse dome of light rising under a dark scrim, with a white hotspot burning through where it meets the bottom edge. Drag the light on the canvas to move it.

name: Peaks
description: Two blurred domes standing against a white-to-black sky, the front one offset further than the back as the light moves. Drag the light on the canvas to move it.

name: Mesh
description: A SwiftUI MeshGradient you build by dragging. Move the control points on the canvas, colour each one, add a drift, and export a native MeshGradient view — no Metal, no shader, iOS 18+.

params.label: Pin edges
params.hint: Keep drifting points on the frame

name: Grain
description: A slow, breathing colour field: a 3x3 palette grid sampled through a time-warped cubic Hermite, finished with film grain. Four palette presets — Umbrellas, Sunset, Ocean, Forest — and all nine grid colours stay editable.

name: Smoke
description: A slow plume of 5-octave value noise drifting upward, thinning along its length and gamma-curved to keep the edge tight. Two colours: the room it sits in, and the smoke itself.

name: Loading Data
description: A GPU force-directed 'network of the mind' loading animation: scattered dots gather into clusters, wire up with live lines, get toured by a scripted camera, then fold into one glowing ball as a status readout counts to 100%. Exports a self-contained MetalKit + SwiftUI bundle.

params.label: Loop
params.hint: Replay with a fresh layout when it finishes

name: Shape
description: A tumbling 3D solid — translucent faces with crisp screen-space edges, rendered by a real MetalKit vertex pipeline. Pick from 22 shapes and set independent fill and edge colours; export a self-contained SwiftUI + Metal pair.

name: Fluid
description: A real Navier–Stokes fluid you can touch — drag across the preview to stir glowing dye through vorticity, a Jacobi pressure solve and a bloom chain. Exports a self-contained MetalKit renderer.

params.label: Rainbow
params.hint: Full-spectrum dye — turn off to use your own colour

name: Glass Orb
description: A raymarched wavy-glass orb in nine styles — Wave (electric indigo ridges), Ember (fast warm folds), Mint (fine pale-green ripples), Frost (crystalline icy ridges), Sky (quiet pale-blue shimmer), Storm (chaotic steel bands), Coral (crossing peach waves), Ice (tight cyan ripples), Magenta (drifting vivid ripples). Every style is real glass — light refracts through to the back surface for deep colored valleys. Tune the glass colour, ripple frequency, depth and speed; the rest of each orb's personality lives in its standalone .metal.

name: Ripple
description: Pulsed water ripples that warp the image — a fresh ring is emitted from the origin every Delay seconds, expands outward, and fades with distance, leaving a real gap between rings. Exports as a SwiftUI layerEffect you apply to your own image (an asset named "forge").

name: Nova
description: A breathing, boiling plasma star raymarched in six styles — Solar (warm pulsing core), Golden (calm two-beat sun), Emerald (green star spinning as it boils), Violet (wobbling magenta heart), Crimson (furnace with erupting flares), Aurora (iridescent gradient star). Edit each colour zone individually — Surface, Core and Halo — plus a global Tint, Background, and the surface turbulence, camera, brightness / contrast / saturation.

name: Earth
description: A dotted globe spun from a real land mask, with three styles — Metal Dots (lit chrome globe), Radar Ping (green sonar sweep with land blips), and Contour Mono (B&W elevation contours). Pure colorEffect, no source image.

name: Particle Field
description: A living cloud of 150k additive point sprites in four styles — Sand Cloud, Pollen Field, Wave Surface, and Ripples. Drag to push the particles around. Exports as a self-contained MetalKit ContentView.swift plus the chosen style's standalone .metal file — no sliders, no effect list.

name: Dots
description: Seven animated dot-field styles in one effect — four 3D perspective grids (Wavy, Mountains, Ocean, Standing Wave) and three flat patterns (Flow Field, Plasma, Snake Trails). Each ships its own focused .metal file; the unified live preview branches on style.

name: Plasma
description: Animated plasma in five styles — Solar (warm waves), Prism (rotating chromatic split), Spectrum (vertical chroma cascade), Ember (smoldering with hot pinpricks), Lilac (slow breathing pulse). Each style ships its own 5-stop palette and shares the scale / intensity / distortion controls.

name: Starfield
description: Multi-layer twinkling stars drifting downward with parallax. Pure colorEffect — no source image required.
swatch: radial-gradient(circle 1.4px at 8px 9px, #fff 50%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(circle 1px at 26px 14px, #fff 50%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(circle 1.7px at 16px 26px, #fff 50%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(circle 0.9px at 28px 28px, #fff 50%, transparent 60%), linear-gradient(180deg, #0a0a1c 0%, #000 100%)

name: Fractal Clouds
description: Drifting fractal clouds rendered with two passes of 5-octave value noise. The first FBM warps the second, producing soft cumulus swirls; a warm tint adds ambient lift.

name: Ink Smoke
description: Domain-warped fbm forms slow-curling ink tendrils. Four ink tones blend by the warped field; a wispy highlight rides the bright peaks.

name: Liquid Chrome
description: Three domain-warped value-noise samples drive a gamma-shaped chrome curve with smoothstep highlights and a power-curve specular glint. Pure colorEffect — no source image required.
